promotes.case: Northpointe Bancshares (Grand Rapids; Feb-2025 IPO): 1.01x book, ROE 12-14%, $7.4B assets growing fast; FDIC cert 34953: NCOs ~ZERO (0.02% ann), C&D concentration FALLING 34->19% of RBC over 5 qtrs, uninsured only 7.7%. Under-followed post-IPO orphan at book with pristine credit.
promotes.trap: WHOLESALE-FUNDED MORTGAGE BANK: brokered deposits 58.6% of total (insured wholesale, but rate-sensitive funding cost); business = mortgage purchase program + warehouse -> gain-on-sale cyclicality (a leveraged rate-cut bet, the inverse-FSBW funding profile). Screen's !COMMON flag = preferred in the cap structure - rank NI-to-COMMON at court.
promotes.court_question: is 1.0x book cheap for a wholesale-funded GoS-cyclical mortgage bank, or fair for the funding model? NIM/GoS decomposition + preferred drag + what a 100bp cut does to both sides.

promotes.case: Oportun: the OMF print-pattern in small-cap form - NCOs at guided PEAK Q1 (12.65%, midpoint of guide) with a committed declining path (Q2 guide 12.2%, FY 11.9%+-50bps), FY adj EPS guided $1.50-1.65 vs px $5.70 = ~3.6x ADJUSTED; 0.66x book; profitability streak intact per Q1 slides.
promotes.trap: ADJUSTED-quality (heavy add-backs - GAAP bridge mandatory at court); mc $262M (below the screen's $300M floor - liquidity/size gate); ABS-funded (funding-cost beta); mission-lender mix shift still in flight.
promotes.court_question: does the GAAP bridge survive scrutiny (what exactly is added back and does it recur), and is the NCO glide-path management's hope or underwriting-cohort math? If both pass, 3.6x adjusted at 0.66x book is the pool's best asymmetry.

promotes.case: Stewart Information Services: title at the housing trough, 1.29x book, mc $2.1B, mid-range (52w 57-79); the #4 title player with the most operating leverage to any existing-home-sales normalization; margin self-help program under way.
promotes.trap: same axis as FNF (already resting 210@48 - the no-cap regime makes this INFORMATION not a blocker, but the court should prefer ONE); STC is the lower-margin operator (that IS the leverage and the risk); commercial title mix smaller than FNF's.
promotes.court_question: trough-on-trough math: what does FY26 EPS look like if existing-home sales stay at 4.0M SAAR through 2027, and is 1.29x book paying for recovery that needs rates to deliver? Head-to-head vs adding to the FNF band.

demotes.why: quality-at-FULL with real flags: 1.59x book near 52w high; FDIC cert 33503: C&D 71% of RBC + uninsured 43% (both structurally high even with ~zero NCOs). Reopen <~1.3x book or C&D <50%.

NOT the improving-NCO pattern: Q1 NCL 12.5% (+10bps YoY, flat), 30+ DQ 7.2% (+10bps YoY), and the stock at 92nd pct of range (+69% EPS already re-rated). Reopen on a credit-print pullback to ~$34-36 (1.0x TBV was the floor).

BDC class (TSLX/HTGC/GSBD/MSIF/BCSF/BBDC/OBDC) stays demoted per scan-7 (discount = forward marks + fee drag); FRMEP/DGICB = preferred lines (screen artifacts); NRIM 2.1x TBV = not cheap; identity-break names stand demoted.

NPB adds mortgage-credit+funding beta, OPRT adds subprime consumer, STC adds housing-transaction beta - all three correlate with the existing axis in a hard-landing tail; the short sleeve (stream D) is the offset under construction.
